title: Rgb::hue returns NaN for a gray
why: For a gray, spread is 0 and (g - b) / spread is 0/0 (paint.rs:54-67). The only callers are the two in tests/reader/inline_code.rs:99-100.
size: 2 test files, about 6 lines, 2 call sites
guards: tests/reader/inline_code.rs on_sepia_inline_code_is_on_the_green_side_of_a_link. PRs 23, 26 and 27 also add to paint.rs (other functions).

title: A comment in the theme tests is garbled
why: src/theme/tests.rs:81-83 reads 'A link is told from code by its underline and code by its face whatever the two colors are'.
diff:
- // The tint is the code's own. A link is told from code by its
- // underline and code by its face whatever the two colors are,
- // which `tests/reader/inline_code.rs` reads.
+ // The tint is the code's own. Whatever the two colors are, a link is
+ // told by its underline and code by its face, which
+ // `tests/reader/inline_code.rs` reads.
